rationale: Cursor's review and mine independently name Claude's plan the implementation base because it alone runs cleanup after detachIssue and reports refusals as logged results rather than a throw that would exit 2 and strand a completed issue's tmux and Terminal windows, and Codex's own review concedes its plan's pre-detach ordering must be revised; the peers' three agreed corrections — an all-clones read-only preflight before the first destructive command, binding the checkout to the fetched origin/<base> tip instead of a best-effort local fallback, and dropping the diverged-local-base refusal from wipe's normal path — fold into that plan without changing its shape.
